data.name: Hansh
data.gender_notes: Hansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Hans’, which means ‘joy’ or ‘delight’. The name Hansh signifies the divine grace and blessings of the gods. It is believed that a child named Hansh is blessed with immense joy and happiness in life. The name Hansh carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hansh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
